placements.title: Perspective is the asset; substrate is the commodity
placements.theme: Intelligence you own — the perspective you keep — is categorically distinct from intelligence you rent; the substrate is interchangeable, the perspective is the retained asset.
placements.why: All three segments cohere under one thematic direction: src-1 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-2 identifies what is commodity (substrate) versus what is asset (perspective), and src-3 explicitly names this as the individually-owned-intelligence thesis. No existing leaf or strata exists to hold this — the graph is empty. The grain test passes: this names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (the ownership of intelligence as a strategic distinction), not a one-time fact.
